editorial:
Imagine getting a phone call from a dad you haven't seen since you were five years old. That is exactly what happens to the lead character here, and it sets up a really emotional ride. At first, it feels like your typical family drama about forgiveness and old wounds, but it quickly turns into something way more interesting. You get to see a daughter trying to piece together her past while dealing with a father who has some very weird secrets. The vibe is a mix of a cozy family story and a strange comic book world, making you feel both the sadness of lost time and the wonder of something supernatural.

The acting is top-notch and makes the weird plot twists feel totally real. While the middle part slows down a bit, the payoff is worth the wait because the reveal about the superheroes is handled so well. You should definitely watch this if you like stories that pull at your heartstrings but still surprise you. For the best experience, I suggest streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the small details, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a movie night. If you are a big movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the father didn't leave because he stopped loving her, but because he actually has the power to control the weather. He stayed away to protect her from the dangers that come with being a superhero. In the end, they reconcile and he teaches her that she has these powers too. They choose to stay in each other's lives, finally finding peace and accepting their strange gifts together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family dramas with a magical twist.
